page.title: Skill Centre
page.subtitle: Manage installed skills and MCP servers, or add new ones from the store.

badge.builtinHint: Baked into the sandbox image and cannot be uninstalled. Its bundled scripts and resources are readable by the agent.
badge.hostHint: Installed on the backend host and cannot be uninstalled. Only its SKILL.md applies — the agent cannot read its bundled files, because its tools run in the sandbox.

mine.emptyHint: Pick something from the store, or upload your own.
mine.confirmPack: “{{name}}” is a pack — uninstalling removes all {{count}} skills in it. Continue?

publish.title: Upload to the skill store
publish.updateBody: Replace the public store version with the current “{{name}}”?
publish.publicNotice: After upload, every user can find and install this skill. Make sure it contains no keys, account details, or other private information.

create.title: Create a skill in chat
create.subtitle: Describe the capability you want. The agent will clarify, create, and validate it in a real conversation.
create.briefPlaceholder: For example: create a skill that summarizes competitor updates every week with linked sources.
create.chatHint: You’ll move to a new conversation where you can keep refining it naturally.

install.title: Install
install.dependsTitle: This skill needs an MCP server
install.dependsHint: Its instructions call tools these servers provide. Without them the skill loads and then fails at its first tool call.
install.dependsWarning: Some dependencies are unchecked — the skill may not work.

upload.title: Add a skill or MCP server
upload.subtitle: Add an archive, SKILL.md, Git repository, or MCP server to Mine.
upload.frontmatterHint: Frontmatter supports icon (an emoji) and requires-mcp (MCP server names it depends on).
upload.gitHint: https, git or ssh. An install.sh in the repo runs automatically.
upload.remoteHint: Remote servers try Streamable HTTP first and fall back to SSE.
upload.jsonHint: Accepts an mcpServers / servers wrapper, or a single server object.

jsonError.invalidShape: Unrecognised shape — paste a server object or an mcpServers map.
jsonError.noServers: No MCP servers found in that configuration.
jsonError.needName: A single server object needs a name.

upload.skillTemplate:
---
name: my-skill
description: ...
icon: 🛠️
---
